title: Instabilities in Tokamak Edge Plasmas: A Comprehensive Review
abstract: This talk covers the recent advancements in understanding Edge Localized Modes (ELMs) and their suppression techniques using RMP coils. We discuss simulation results matching recent experiments at ADITYA-U.

title: Solar Wind Interaction with Earth's Magnetosphere
abstract: Analyzing the reconnection events observed by the MMS mission. A detailed look at the electron diffusion region and its implications for space weather forecasting models.

title: High Energy Density Physics with Ultra-Intense Lasers
abstract: Exploring the frontiers of laser-matter interaction at relativistic intensities. Applications in compact particle accelerators and fast ignition fusion schemes.

title: Dusty Plasma Crystal Formation in DC Glow Discharge
abstract: Experimental observation of hexagonal lattice formation in dusty plasma. Analysis of coupling parameter and phase transition dynamics under varying pressure conditions.

title: Status of ITER and Future of Fusion Energy
abstract: An update on the construction progress of the ITER tokamak in France. Challenges in assembly, component manufacturing, and the roadmap to First Plasma.
